title: Introduce degradation ward and ephemeral fallback sentinel to stabilize SLO transitions
author: Samantha Ortiz
release_notes: Introduce Degradation Ward: opt-in SLO-relay and transparent fallback planner to reduce failover churn and improve stable degraded operation. Default disabled.
commits: Implement DegradationGate middleware with probation windows (samantha/ward/gate)

description: Motivation: During a regional surge incident we observed oscillating circuit transitions causing tenant-visible latency spikes and partial degradations. This PR introduces the 'degradation ward' - a lightweight transparent fallback governor that provides a conservative SLO relay and ephemeral fallback sentinel to avoid aggressive circuit flips and reduce cross-region failovers. Changes: 1) SLORelay operator that computes a smoothed SLO deficit metric per-tenant with exponential decay and time-weighted buckets, 2) DegradationGate middleware that applies a graded allow/deny decision with probationary windows, 3) EphemeralFallbackPlanner that reserves a tiny warm standby route and coordinates transparent KV-preserve handoff, 4) Telemetry hooks and new metrics: ward.slo_deficit, ward.probation_events, ward.fallback_reservations, and associated alert thresholds. Why this approach: targets failure modes observed in incident INC-2026-02-09 where fast reopen+failover churn amplified load; aim to prefer soft degrade and tenant probation over hard regional failover. Backwards compatibility: default behavior is opt-in via config flag 'ward.enabled' set to false in cluster config; when disabled runtime is unchanged. Testing: unit tests for SLO relay smoothing and DegradationGate decision matrix, integration test that simulates KV drain and verifies transparent fallback reservation, load test that demonstrates 12% reduction in cross-region failovers at 90th percentile latency under synthetic spike. Commits: - Add SLORelay and smoothing logic (samantha/ward/slo_relay) - Implement DegradationGate middleware with probation windows (samantha/ward/gate) - Add EphemeralFallbackPlanner and reservation protocol (samantha/ward/planner) - Telemetry and dashboards (samantha/ward/telemetry) - Tests and docs (samantha/ward/tests_docs) Files changed: runtime/ward/slo_relay.go, runtime/ward/gate.go, runtime/ward/planner.go, runtime/ward/telemetry.md, runtime/ward/README.md, infra/config/ward_defaults.yaml, telemetry/dashboards/ward_overview.json Reviewers and conversation: Rajiv requested clarifications on SLO smoothing constants and suggested replacing a hard 30s window with exponential decay, author updated smoothing code and added tests; Elena flagged potential lock contention in planner reservation; author introduced sharded reservation map and a benchmark showing negligible contention; Kai approved after CI green and asked to add an emergency disable flag which was added to config. CI: go build/test passed, linters passed, e2e flake on integration reran and passed. Files changed count: 7. Size: +312/-58.
